name: Call of Fire

angles.text: This quest marks a critical spiritual trial for the shaman, transitioning from the endurance of stone to the fierce, destructive power of fire.
With the trial set in the mountains of Dun Morogh, Alliance shamans follow the guidance of their elders to awaken communion with the elements of fire.
Taking place high above South Gate Outpost in Dun Morogh, this rite tests whether a dwarf has the discipline to temper the burning hunger of flame.

faq.answer: Bruegs Kindleborn is a mentor dwelling in a mountain cave high above South Gate Outpost in Dun Morogh. He assesses shamans sent by elders to determine if they possess the maturity and discipline to receive the fire sapta.

A sapta is an elemental draught or preparation that allows a shaman to commune with spirits of that element. The sapta of fire grants communion with flame and its raw power, requiring mental focus and prior grounding in stone.
faq.q: What is the sapta of fire?

aliases: where is call of fire turn in
faq.answer: Bruegs Kindleborn can be found far east in the snowy mountains of Dun Morogh, sheltered in a cave overlooking South Gate Outpost.

Call of Fire is a rite of passage for shamans who have demonstrated patience and mastered earth. It calls them to confront the chaotic power of destruction under the watchful eye of Bruegs Kindleborn.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Call of Fire?

faq.answer: Earth represents steadfast patience, stability, and control. Without the grounding foundation taught by stone, a shaman risks being overwhelmed by the volatile hunger and destructive passions of fire.
faq.q: Why must a shaman learn the lessons of stone before fire?

faq.answer: The quest builds on previous trials where the initiate demonstrated patience and grounded themselves in earth. The elder only sends a student to Bruegs Kindleborn once their discipline is proven solid.
faq.q: What prerequisites are required before undertaking the Call of Fire?

sections.body: After proving patience and grounding through the element of earth, shamans are directed to confront a far more volatile force: the fire elemental spirit. Unlike the steady, unyielding stone, fire calls with promises of chaos, ruin, and ferocious energy. An elder dispatches the initiate across the snow-laden peaks of Dun Morogh to seek guidance before attempting to harness this wild heat.
sections.title: The Burning Trial

sections.body: High in the mountains above South Gate Outpost, the mentor Bruegs Kindleborn keeps watch from a secluded cave. When an initiate arrives bearing an elder's recommendation, Bruegs prepares them for the sapta of fire. Yet he issues a stern warning: the hunger to burn and consume is easily stirred, but mastering flame demands knowing precisely when to hold back.
sections.title: The Recluse of the Peaks

summary: Call of Fire is a shamanic quest guiding initiates into the dangerous, chaotic realm of flame in the heights of Dun Morogh. Having mastered the patient lessons of earth, the practitioner is directed to Bruegs Kindleborn to test their readiness for the fire sapta.
